package.description: A ChatGPT (GPT-3 and GPT-4) powered AI assistant app that runs on your desktop or the web.

en-US.description: A ChatGPT (GPT-3 and GPT-4) powered AI assistant app that runs on your desktop or the web.
en-US.longDescription:
ReadyRunner is a ChatGPT (GPT-3 and GPT-4) powered AI assistant app that runs on your desktop or the web. Use it to write, code, learn and be productive.
ReadyRunner has 3 chat types to help you:
- Assistant chat – standard AI chat
- ScratchPad – collaborate on code or text with the AI assistant
- Document Chat - ask questions about a document
en-US.name: ReadyRunner

zh-CN.description: 由 ChatGPT（GPT-3 和 GPT-4）驱动的人工智能助手应用，可在桌面或网络上运行。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ReadyRunner 是一款由 ChatGPT（GPT-3 和 GPT-4）驱动的人工智能助手应用，可在您的桌面或网络上运行。可以用它来写作、编程、学习并提高工作效率。
ReadyRunner 有 3 种聊天类型可帮助您：
- 助理聊天 - 标准 AI 聊天
- 草稿本 - 与人工智能助手协作编写代码或文本
- 文档聊天 - 询问有关文档的问题
zh-CN.name: ReadyRunner
